products.name: Pic Hider
products.tagline: Private photo & video vault — locked behind your PIN
products.description: Hide photos and videos behind a PIN-encrypted vault (AES-256). Fingerprint/face unlock (works on Class-2 sensors too), built-in viewer with zoom and video playback, and one-tap export back to your gallery. NEW in v1.3.0: the two biggest real-world bugs are fixed for good — 'gallery won't open' (phones whose gallery picker silently fails now get an instant one-tap file-browser fallback) and 'PIN won't save' (vault creation writes are now synchronous, so an aggressive memory killer can never eat a fresh setup; setup failures show a clear in-app message instead of crashing; the lock screen always has a manual Unlock button as a safety net). Plus app disguise (Calculator / Notes / Gallery / custom icon) and recovery question.

products.name: Junk Cleaner
products.tagline: Smart clean + big files + duplicate finder (no root)
products.description: One-tap SMART CLEAN scans shared storage for thumbnail caches, empty folders, leftover installers and temp files — everything reviewed before deletion. NEW in v1.1.0 — BIG FILES: the 25 largest files on your storage with per-file confirm-delete. DUPLICATES: byte-identical copies found via a 3-stage engine (size buckets → 64 KB head hash → full content hash) — one tap keeps the first copy and cleans the rest, always after a review dialog. Plus SYSTEM CACHE BOOST (the official Android storage API pattern, the same lever Google's own tools use) and the per-app APP CACHES dashboard. Never touches Android/data, never deletes without review, no fake RAM/CPU 'boost' nonsense.

notes: NEW BIG FILES: the 25 largest files on storage, per-file confirm delete

products.name: EasyPair
products.tagline: Offline high-speed sharing between two nearby phones — no data, no limits
products.description: Offline transfer between two nearby phones — Wi-Fi Direct, hotspot, same Wi-Fi, USB cable (tethering) and Bluetooth; photos, videos, audio, files, folders, apps (APK) and clipboard text, no limits. NEW in v1.1.0: every received file is registered — the Received Files screen lets you browse everything that landed in Downloads/EasyPair, tap to open it, re-share it onward (single file or all at once) or delete it for good.
